subject: What an ad company does with Muse
headline: Millions handed Meta's Muse their chores. What does an ad company do with an agent that runs your life?

files.name: 1-what-the-reviews-say.png
files.purpose: One person says a shop charged them $6,000 for clothes that cost about $1,500, and Muse wrote to the shop to get the money back. The reviews of Muse.

files.name: 2-similar-jobs.png
files.purpose: A CNN reporter found that ChatGPT and Google's Gemini can do similar jobs.

files.name: 3-closer-not-cleverer.png
files.purpose: Meta owns Instagram, Facebook and WhatsApp. Muse can turn a recipe video you saved on Instagram into a shopping list.

files.name: 4-where-meta-makes-its-money.png
files.purpose: Meta makes almost all its money from adverts: last quarter 60 billion dollars, nearly every dollar from ads.

files.name: 5-pay-to-be-picked.png
files.purpose: On Facebook a shop pays so you'll see it. Inside Muse a shop could pay so your helper chooses it.

files.name: 6-my-prediction.png
files.purpose: My prediction: by 30 June 2027 Meta will let businesses pay so that Muse recommends them to you. 70%.
